title: Dirichlet Eigenvalue Approximation on Manifolds with Cylindrical Boundary
summary: We prove that the Dirichlet eigenvalues of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on a compact Riemannian manifold with cylindrical boundary can be approximated by the spectrum of truncated graph Laplacians constructed from $(\varepsilon,ρ)$-proximity graphs on the manifold. The approximation is uniform over a class $\mathcal{M}$ of manifolds, characterized by bounds on Ricci curvature, a lower bound on the injectivity radius, and an upper bound on the diameter.
